# guardium-data-protection_aws_vpc_cleanup (Resource)

Cleans up AWS resources orphaned in a VPC by Kubernetes (ALB/NLB load balancers, Classic ELBs, NAT Gateways, security groups, ENIs) that are not tracked by Terraform. On `terraform destroy`, removes these resources so that VPC/subnet/IGW deletion succeeds without manual intervention.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `region` (String) AWS region where the VPC resides.
- `vpc_id` (String) ID of the VPC to clean up orphaned resources in.

### Optional

- `access_key_id` (String, Sensitive) AWS access key ID. Takes precedence over `profile` and the standard SDK credential chain.
- `profile` (String) AWS named profile. Used when `access_key_id`/`secret_access_key` are not set.
- `secret_access_key` (String, Sensitive) AWS secret access key. Required when `access_key_id` is set.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
